item.tib: dbal phur khro bcu gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen sgrub lag len ud 'bar me tog skal ldan snang ba'i dga' ston snang ba'i dga' ston
item.coloph: ces pa'i blo ldan gyi snyan rgyud phur pa bsnyen sgrub las la sbyor tshul zin ris 'di kyang bla ma g.yung drung tshul khrims dbang grags kyis khyung dkar g.yung drung bstan rgyas gling du bcad rgya'i thun mtshams su bris pa'o//
